lines.text: @maya_front walks the path, an empty leash dangling from her hand.
Far off, @dog_rex spots her and tears across the grass.
Mud flies from his paws as he plows through a puddle.
A muddy @dog_rex leaps into @maya_front's arms, knocking her hat off.
She laughs, mud streaking her coat, and hugs him tight.
The hat rolls away in the grass, forgotten.

writes.note: I drafted a short park scene from your line, with a single spoken beat.

reply.rationale: Expanded the one-line moment into a one-location 15 s scene (about 14 s by rule 10) keeping both @names as written and the hat-knocking beat.
